landing.eyebrow: ForFuture — இளைஞர் குரல்கள். உண்மையான செயல். சிறந்த நாளை.
landing.heroTitle: பேசவும், ஒழுங்குபடுத்தவும், எதிர்காலத்தை வடிவமைக்கவும் இளைஞர்களை வலுப்படுத்துதல்.
landing.heroSubtitle: கருத்துகளை பகிரவும், உங்கள் குரலை உயர்த்தவும், தன்னார்வ இயக்கங்களில் சேரவும், நம்பகமான பிரச்சாரங்களுக்கு ஆதரவு அளிக்கவும்.
landing.featuresSubtitle: ForFuture empowers youth to share ideas, raise concerns, create movements, and turn collective voices into meaningful change.
landing.featureSpeakText: Use your profile or Youth Voice ID to share meaningful thoughts safely.
landing.featureActionText: Create volunteer drives, fundraising campaigns, civic actions, and impact movements.
landing.featurePollText: Use Quick Youth Polls to understand what young people care about.
landing.featureTrustText: Verified Organizations and Trusted Campaign badges help people act with confidence.
landing.whyIdeasText: Youth often have strong ideas but fear judgment. ForFuture gives you a place to be heard.
landing.whyIdentityText: Post with your profile or use a private Youth Voice ID when you need privacy.
landing.whyActionText: Turn concerns into volunteer drives, polls, campaigns, and lawful peaceful civic participation.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join ForFuture to create movements, support youth-led change, or explore momentum as a guest — no account required.

moderation.reportSubtitle: Help keep ForFuture safe and respectful. Reports are reviewed by our team.
moderation.reason_misinformation_desc: False or misleading claims presented as fact
moderation.reason_abuse_harassment_desc: Bullying, targeted harassment, or personal attacks
moderation.reason_hate_discriminatory_desc: Attacks based on identity, protected characteristics, or group membership
moderation.reason_spam_scam_desc: Unwanted promotion, fraud, phishing, or deceptive solicitations
moderation.reason_threats_incitement_desc: Threats of harm or encouragement of violence
moderation.reason_other_desc: Another concern that should be reviewed by our team
moderation.featureBlurb: ForFuture supports open civic expression while maintaining a safe and respectful community. Users can report harmful content, misinformation, abuse, scams, or privacy violations. Reports are reviewed rather than automatically removing content.
